All six key orders crossed with LF/CRLF and optional final newline; spaces, tabs, blank lines, Unicode comments and comments immediately following values; all eight key-presence subsets; missing-key details and EOF offsets; every duplicate key, invalid duplicate values, case-sensitive unknown keys, and byte offsets after Unicode comments.

Tables, array tables, dotted and quoted keys, arrays, inline tables, literal and triple-quoted strings, multiline strings and assignments; malformed punctuation, missing values, signed or nondecimal integers, leading-zero TOML integers and extra tokens; zero through u32::MAX format values separated from compatibility policy; twelve full-width model/runtime combinations; embedded semver errors rebased after multibyte comments; escape rejection, controls, quoted hashes, bare carriage returns and unsupported whitespace.

Exactly 65,536 bytes accepted and larger inputs rejected before syntax work; multibyte text counted by encoded bytes; synthetic usize::MAX, u32::MAX and next-address boundaries without oversized allocation; checked diagnostic addition; every truncation of the minimal complete document rejected with in-range offsets.

Inclusive runtime equality, smaller minor versions with maximum patch, future patch/minor/major requirements, maximum versions, exact model matching in each component, independent model/runtime namespaces, deterministic format/model/runtime failure order, repeated errors, and immutable inputs.

Root load_model integration across RON parsing, defaults, zero ids/codes, roles, recursive nominal references, stream responses, errors, headers and version validation; required and optional metadata, supplied invalid metadata, mismatches, future runtimes, record and string model versions, and parse/normalization/semantic/compatibility error precedence.
